invariants.rationale: File name should not be null because it is used to load resources and would throw an exception.
Empty filenames are usually invalid for resource loading.
File name should have at least one character for a valid path.
The loader likely expects Tiled Map JSON/XML files, which typically have .tmj or .tmx extensions.
Trimming the filename should not change its length, indicating no leading/trailing whitespace (often required for file operations).
